_about: Numbers cited by the hri-experience-platform kit. Every entry has class 'public' (a cited public document, value as published) or 'illustrative' (a round design parameter or example invented to keep the shape of a design rule; never a measurement). No number here is copied from any internal source. Derived values in the notes are labelled 'my arithmetic'. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.

ros2_default_history_depth.source: ROS 2 documentation, 'Quality of Service settings', section 'QoS profiles' (default for publishers and subscriptions: keep last, queue size 10, reliable, volatile). https://docs.ros.org/en/kilted/Concepts/Intermediate/About-Quality-of-Service-Settings.html

cancel_settle_target_ms_illustrative.source: design parameter; one target adapter's bound for positive proof that a cancelled primitive is quiet. Must be <= cancel_settle_ceiling_ms_illustrative and < cleanup_ack_timeout_ms_illustrative

cancel_settle_ceiling_ms_illustrative.source: design parameter; catalog-wide ceiling pinned in the deployment profile, shared by every target

cleanup_ack_timeout_ms_illustrative.source: design parameter; kernel cleanup acknowledgement deadline. Every settle bound must be strictly shorter

gesture_wait_timeout_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; experience-policy timer for the 'await wave' local state of the example wave experience

chat_turns_illustrative.source: design parameter; bounded number of conversation turns in the example chat experience

chat_turn_budget_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; per-turn time budget for one conversation turn

chat_session_bound_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; upper bound on one kernel-owned conversation session

same_visit_absence_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; how long a visitor may leave view and still be the same visit in the earlier single-tracker design

decline_limit_illustrative.source: design parameter; consecutive explicit declines after which the earlier single-tracker design stops proactive offers

transition_stream_depth_illustrative.source: design parameter; bounded history depth of the transition stream in the earlier single-tracker design

old_effect_kinds_illustrative.source: illustrative order of magnitude of a story-specific effect vocabulary in a single-experience coordinator, before the generic vocabulary replaced it

baseline_local_states_illustrative.source: illustrative size of the story of the richest earlier experience, used in the regeneration example

sim_cold_start_s_illustrative.source: illustrative order of magnitude of a physics-simulator cold start to a healthy scene; not a measurement

sim_launch_timeout_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; launch bound, chosen larger than the cold start

sim_retire_timeout_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; bound on stopping and retiring one simulation instance

sim_rebind_grace_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; grace in which the same browser page may rebind after its application channel drops

sim_inactivity_s_illustrative.source: design parameter; visitor inactivity deadline renewed only by meaningful activity

matrix_profiles_illustrative.source: illustrative number of experience profiles validated by the serial profile-matrix runner

matrix_run_s_illustrative.source: illustrative scenario run time per profile in the serial matrix

observatory_session_ttl_h_illustrative.source: design parameter; maximum lifetime of one cloud observatory session cell

observatory_idle_min_illustrative.source: design parameter; idle timeout that stops one cloud observatory session cell
